title: Training vs Sky Striker
summary: Sky Striker is a control deck that wants an empty Main Monster Zone, Link-2 access (Kagari/Shizuku/Hayate), and recursive spells (Engage, Hornet Drones, Widow Anchor). Deny their spell economy and force them into dead turns.
winConditions: Flood the board so they cannot Link comfortably, or play under their grind with denser engines
Resolve a turn that banishes Engage/Anchor from GY
Present multiple threats so one Widow Anchor is not enough
keyCardsRespect: Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage! — search engine
keyCardsNegate: Engage when it would refill their hand
Kagari recycle when it recovers Engage/Anchor
Widow Anchor on your only extender

tips.title: Spell GY matters
tips.body: Striker gets stronger as spells pile in GY. Called by / shuffle / banish hurts more than raw damage sometimes.

tips.title: Empty MMZ
tips.body: They prefer zero monsters in their Main Monster Zones. Occupying zones or forcing bodies can dilute lines.

tips.title: Play through Anchor
tips.body: Keep a second threat or follow-up so one Anchor does not end your turn.

handtrapGuidance: Ash Engage when it is clearly the refill; sometimes hold for Kagari if you know Anchor is next.
Droll is excellent if they search multiple times in a turn.
Imperm Kagari or Raye when Raye is the only name on field.
commonMistakes: Overextending into Widow Anchor with a one-card turn
Letting Shizuku search for free every End Phase
Ignoring spell recursion and only playing for damage
